item: Analytics 4-5 are looked at in Chromium (80 runs, fixtures) and the phone-width column cut-off it found is fixed down to 320 px
status: shipped (Chromium-verified in the remote sandbox on fixture rows; real rows await the operator's walk)
key_paths: scripts/analytics45_seed.py; scripts/analytics45_look.py; scripts/csp_sweep.py; tests/test_analytics45_seed.py; src/static/app.css; docs/audit/analytics45-look-2026-10-12/; docs/product/RELEASE_0.5_GATE.md
summary: R126's walk for S4: 80 runs (1440x900, 768x1024, 390x844, 360x800, 320x568 x 15 theme settings in English, plus Arabic at the first theme) on an offline loopback app (online:false asserted per context and at the end of each run), every drop-down in the Wikipedia panel picked and read back from the control now on screen (the page redraws it on every pick; csp_sweep now records that by node identity), each figure of both readers judged against a seeded state's own truth, a console line failing the run: 2,245 checks, 0 failed, 0 console lines, 0 CSP events, 0 requests off the loopback origin; mutation_checks.py shows the judges can fail (4 of 4 caught). It found one real defect: at 390 px the two tables were 24 and 48 px wider than their frame, cutting the last column off behind a sideways scroll the page did not show; a padding-only fix fitted 390 px but not 360 or 320 px, so app.css also steps the type down (smallest headroom 62/56 px at 390, 32/26 at 360, 16/18 at 320). The UX pass for these two readers is closed; the clause 'render from real rows' is not (the rows are the seed's).
